scene_description: A child and an adult are sitting outside at a table covered with a Halloween spider-web tablecloth. They are carving orange pumpkins. One pumpkin already has a face carved on it, and another has a drawn-on design. Several pumpkins and pumpkin pieces are on the table.

questions.question: What are they carving?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big orange things on the table.

questions.question: What color are the pumpkins?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big round things on the table.

questions.question: Who is touching the pumpkin?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the people sitting at the table.

questions.question: Where are the pumpkins?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is under the pumpkins.

questions.question: What is on the tablecloth?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the pattern on the brown cloth on the table.
